#!/usr/bin/env bash
# snapshot.sh — as-of evidence snapshots for this project.
#
# A snapshot records the full state of the project tree (excluding build/
# and the snapshot store itself) at a given timestamp, together with a
# SHA-256 manifest of every captured file. Each snapshot is chained to the
# previous one by embedding the hash of its manifest, so the evidence trail
# cannot be reordered or altered without detection.
#
# Usage:
#   ./snapshot.sh capture [--at <UTC-ISO-8601>]   Record a snapshot
#   ./snapshot.sh list                            List snapshots
#   ./snapshot.sh verify [<id>]                   Verify integrity (all if no id)
#
# verify reports, per snapshot:
#   integrity — every stored file still matches its manifest hash
#   chain     — the hash of the previous snapshot's manifest still matches
#   drift     — how the current tree differs from the as-of state
#             (informational; does not affect the exit code)
#
# The snapshot store location can be overridden with SNAPSHOTS_DIR
# (default: ./snapshots).

set -euo pipefail

cd "$(dirname "$0")"

SNAPSHOTS_DIR="${SNAPSHOTS_DIR:-snapshots}"

die() { echo "snapshot.sh: error: $*" >&2; exit 1; }

hash_file() { sha256sum "$1" | cut -d' ' -f1; }

manifest_field() { awk -F= -v k="$2" '$1==k{print $2}' "$1"; }

validate_ts() {
    if ! printf '%s\n' "$1" | grep -Eq '^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}T[0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2}Z$'; then
        die "invalid timestamp '$1' — expected UTC ISO-8601, e.g. 2026-10-07T12:00:00Z"
    fi
    if ! date -u -d "$1" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
        die "invalid timestamp '$1' — not a real date/time"
    fi
}

# Sorted list of project files (paths relative to the project root).
list_project_files() {
    case "$SNAPSHOTS_DIR" in
        /*|..*) find . -type f ! -path './build/*' -printf '%P\n' | LC_ALL=C sort ;;
        *)      find . -type f ! -path './build/*' ! -path "./${SNAPSHOTS_DIR#./}/*" -printf '%P\n' | LC_ALL=C sort ;;
    esac
}

latest_snapshot_id() {
    [ -d "$SNAPSHOTS_DIR" ] || return 0
    find "$SNAPSHOTS_DIR" -mindepth 1 -maxdepth 1 -type d -printf '%f\n' | LC_ALL=C sort | tail -n 1
}

cmd_capture() {
    local as_of=""
    while [ $# -gt 0 ]; do
        case "$1" in
            --at)
                [ $# -ge 2 ] || die "--at requires a timestamp"
                as_of="$2"; shift 2 ;;
            *) die "unknown option: $1" ;;
        esac
    done
    if [ -n "$as_of" ]; then
        validate_ts "$as_of"
    else
        as_of="$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)"
    fi

    local id dir
    id="$(printf '%s' "$as_of" | tr -d ':-')"
    dir="$SNAPSHOTS_DIR/$id"
    if [ -e "$dir" ]; then
        die "snapshot '$id' already exists — refusing to overwrite existing evidence"
    fi

    local files_tmp; files_tmp="$(mktemp)"
    list_project_files > "$files_tmp"
    local count; count="$(wc -l < "$files_tmp" | tr -d ' ')"

    local prev_id prev_hash
    prev_id="$(latest_snapshot_id)"
    if [ -n "$prev_id" ]; then
        prev_hash="$(hash_file "$SNAPSHOTS_DIR/$prev_id/manifest.tsv")"
    else
        prev_id="none"; prev_hash="none"
    fi

    mkdir -p "$dir/files"
    local captured_at; captured_at="$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)"

    {
        echo "# MyCC as-of evidence snapshot"
        echo "manifest_version=1"
        echo "snapshot_id=$id"
        echo "as_of=$as_of"
        echo "captured_at=$captured_at"
        echo "prev_snapshot=$prev_id"
        echo "prev_manifest_sha256=$prev_hash"
        echo "file_count=$count"
        echo "# columns: path, sha256, size"
    } > "$dir/manifest.tsv.tmp"

    local p
    while IFS= read -r p; do
        [ -z "$p" ] && continue
        mkdir -p "$dir/files/$(dirname "$p")"
        cp -p "$p" "$dir/files/$p"
        printf '%s\t%s\t%s\n' "$p" "$(hash_file "$p")" "$(stat -c %s "$p")"
    done < "$files_tmp" >> "$dir/manifest.tsv.tmp"

    mv "$dir/manifest.tsv.tmp" "$dir/manifest.tsv"
    rm -f "$files_tmp"

    echo "Captured snapshot $id"
    echo "  as_of:       $as_of"
    echo "  captured_at: $captured_at"
    echo "  files:       $count"
    echo "  manifest:    $(hash_file "$dir/manifest.tsv")"
}

verify_one() {
    local id="$1"
    local dir="$SNAPSHOTS_DIR/$id"
    local manifest="$dir/manifest.tsv"
    local rc=0 matched=0 total=0 changed=0 added=0 deleted=0

    if [ ! -f "$manifest" ]; then
        echo "Snapshot $id: FAIL (manifest missing)"
        return 1
    fi

    # --- integrity: stored files vs manifest hashes
    declare -A mhash=()
    local p h s
    while IFS=$'\t' read -r p h s; do
        total=$((total+1))
        mhash["$p"]="$h"
        if [ ! -f "$dir/files/$p" ]; then
            echo "  integrity FAIL: missing file: $p"; rc=1
        elif [ "$(hash_file "$dir/files/$p")" != "$h" ]; then
            echo "  integrity FAIL: hash mismatch: $p"; rc=1
        else
            matched=$((matched+1))
        fi
    done < <(awk -F'\t' 'NF>=3 && $1 !~ /^#/' "$manifest")

    local declared; declared="$(manifest_field "$manifest" file_count)"
    if [ "$declared" != "$total" ]; then
        echo "  integrity FAIL: manifest declares $declared files but lists $total"; rc=1
    fi

    # --- chain: hash of the previous manifest must still match
    local prev_id prev_hash chain_line
    prev_id="$(manifest_field "$manifest" prev_snapshot)"
    prev_hash="$(manifest_field "$manifest" prev_manifest_sha256)"
    if [ "$prev_id" = "none" ]; then
        chain_line="none (first snapshot)"
    else
        local prev_manifest="$SNAPSHOTS_DIR/$prev_id/manifest.tsv"
        if [ ! -f "$prev_manifest" ]; then
            chain_line="FAIL (previous snapshot $prev_id missing)"; rc=1
        elif [ "$(hash_file "$prev_manifest")" != "$prev_hash" ]; then
            chain_line="FAIL (previous manifest hash mismatch — history altered)"; rc=1
        else
            chain_line="PASS (links to $prev_id)"
        fi
    fi

    # --- drift: current tree vs the as-of state (informational)
    local mtmp ctmp; mtmp="$(mktemp)"; ctmp="$(mktemp)"
    if [ "$total" -gt 0 ]; then
        printf '%s\n' "${!mhash[@]}" | LC_ALL=C sort > "$mtmp"
        for p in "${!mhash[@]}"; do
            if [ ! -f "$p" ]; then
                deleted=$((deleted+1))
            elif [ "$(hash_file "$p")" != "${mhash[$p]}" ]; then
                changed=$((changed+1))
            fi
        done
    fi
    list_project_files > "$ctmp"
    added="$(comm -13 "$mtmp" "$ctmp" | wc -l | tr -d ' ')"
    rm -f "$mtmp" "$ctmp"

    echo "Snapshot $id (as of $(manifest_field "$manifest" as_of))"
    if [ "$rc" -eq 0 ]; then
        echo "  integrity: PASS ($matched/$total files match manifest)"
    else
        echo "  integrity: FAIL"
    fi
    echo "  chain:     $chain_line"
    echo "  drift:     changed=$changed added=$added deleted=$deleted"
    return $rc
}

cmd_verify() {
    local rc=0
    if [ $# -gt 0 ]; then
        verify_one "$1" || rc=1
    else
        local ids=()
        if [ -d "$SNAPSHOTS_DIR" ]; then
            mapfile -t ids < <(find "$SNAPSHOTS_DIR" -mindepth 1 -maxdepth 1 -type d -printf '%f\n' | LC_ALL=C sort)
        fi
        if [ "${#ids[@]}" -eq 0 ]; then
            echo "No snapshots found in $SNAPSHOTS_DIR"
            return 1
        fi
        local i
        for i in "${ids[@]}"; do
            verify_one "$i" || rc=1
            echo
        done
    fi
    return $rc
}

cmd_list() {
    if [ ! -d "$SNAPSHOTS_DIR" ]; then
        echo "No snapshots found in $SNAPSHOTS_DIR"
        return 0
    fi
    local d id any=0
    while IFS= read -r d; do
        id="$(basename "$d")"
        if [ -f "$d/manifest.tsv" ]; then
            printf '%s  as_of=%s  files=%s  manifest_sha256=%s\n' "$id" \
                "$(manifest_field "$d/manifest.tsv" as_of)" \
                "$(manifest_field "$d/manifest.tsv" file_count)" \
                "$(hash_file "$d/manifest.tsv")"
            any=1
        else
            echo "$id  (no manifest)"
            any=1
        fi
    done < <(find "$SNAPSHOTS_DIR" -mindepth 1 -maxdepth 1 -type d -printf '%p\n' | LC_ALL=C sort)
    [ "$any" -eq 1 ] || echo "No snapshots found in $SNAPSHOTS_DIR"
}

usage() {
    sed -n '2,25p' "$0" | sed 's/^# \{0,1\}//'
}

case "${1:-help}" in
    capture) shift; cmd_capture "$@" ;;
    list)    cmd_list ;;
    verify)  shift; cmd_verify "$@" ;;
    help|*)  usage ;;
esac
